hero.description: My goal is to stand by people through education, social service, and technology. From Sunamganj, I dream of building a better digital world.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: From village to city, dream to reality — a continuous journey
about.story1: I am Rahat Ahmed. I was born on June 21, 2006 in Jibdara village, Shantiganj, Sunamganj. This village, raised in the lap of nature, taught me to dream and to fight.
about.story2: Currently I am a 2nd year HSC student in the Science department at Sunamganj Government College. Alongside studies, I am a teacher, co-founder and General Secretary of Shantichakra Blood Society, and an active BNCC cadet.
about.story3: I love working on web development, artificial intelligence, content creation, and social service. My goal is to bring positive change in society through education and technology.
about.quote: Standing by people, learning, and teaching — these three things drive me forward.
